title: R01 applies to the X9R9A Ver:003 build: MemorySubClass is byte-identical
configuration: One image analysed offline; no hardware involved
observations: MemorySubClass (6A3DEF38-0A45-4107-A74E-ABF2B8EAED86) extracted from this build and from the March build is the same 12512 bytes, SHA-256 3655165ca3d4af7aedf152f70064f8660a16b215b5f67d05d979bd94d8299253, as recorded in the variant's source hash.
The variant is the March variant unchanged: same hunks, source and result hashes.

bme patch built an image from the dump (input SHA-256 078459d5bce27875cdf193ee4ebfdd4deb523a4ea1fcf855e436cbe540739133); bme verify reproduced it from the catalog. The module grows by 160 bytes and the volume is reflowed, as on the March build: 74 changed regions on this build.
With this variant and B02-B03 recorded, bme scan identifies the build by 2 of 2 recorded modules.
limits: Offline only. The patched image was never flashed or booted on this build; the Linux observation of corrected DIMM widths exists for the March build only. The reflowed volume layout of this build was not booted.
source: bme extract, bme patch and bme verify, 2026-11-13
